name: Smoky Constitution
description: The creature spends its time in both gaseous and solid form. Its unique constitution makes it immune to all fog- or gas-related spells and attacks, including its own. a creature sees clearly through light or heavy obscurement caused by fog, mist, or spells such as fog cloud.
